== Card list ==

Six die-cut packs. Each pack contains '''one''' premium character (visible through the window) plus four [[Premiere Unlimited]] boosters. The boosters are not listed.

=== Luke With Lightsaber pack ===

Permanent weapon is •Luke's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny &gt; defense value).
|}
